ModMetaData.name: Mech Upgrade Policies
ModMetaData.author: Ordoxous
ModMetaData.description:
Upgrade policies for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3365118555]Mechanoid Upgrades[/url], set up the way you set apparel policies for colonists.
Give a mech a policy, and it goes to an auto mech upgrader by itself. There it fills its upgrade points with the upgrades the policy allows, from the upgrader's linked storages, and has the upgrades the policy doesn't allow removed. Every mech upgrader becomes an auto mech upgrader; you can still use it by hand as before.
[h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*]A policy editor with a live preview: what a mech type gets from the policy, what's skipped and why, and what changes for the mech you opened it from. Load a policy from one of your saved upgrade sets. [*]Rank upgrades by dragging them, to choose what a mech gets when it can't fit everything, and optionally have mechs swap lower-ranked upgrades for better ones as they come into stock. [*]Assign policies from the Mechs tab or from the mech's own buttons, which work on several mechs at once. [*]Hover over a policy to see each upgrade's state for that mech: installed, added or removed on its next trip, wanted but not in stock, or skipped. [*]Markers on the Mechs tab for mechs with changes waiting, wanted upgrades not in stock, or no usable upgrader. [*]Alerts listing the upgrades your policies want and you don't have, and mechs that can't reach an upgrader. [*]The upgrader shows its stock, and which mechs are on their way or waiting. [/list]
Mechs without a policy are left alone, so existing upgrades are safe until you assign one. You can change this, how often mechs check their policy, and the alerts, in the mod settings.
Source available on [url=https://github.com/Ordoxous/RimworldMods/tree/master/MechUpgradesUi]GitHub[/url].
